Frontend E2E via Playwright fully green: register/?ref= prefill, photo upload with primary label, payout submission → pending, withdraw dialog disabled + warning until verified, referral card, mutual-like → NotificationBell unread badge (=1) + panel lists match item, admin sees wallet-admin-link → /admin shows pending accounts → approve works.

issues: React a11y console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}'. Non-blocking but should add DialogDescription to each Dialog for screen readers.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py list_profiles (lines 333-353): the 'rest' query when q is provided nests {"$and":[{"$or": query['$or']}, {"$or":[...]}]} while query itself still contains a $or key from the search term — MongoDB accepts both, but the code is fragile. Recommend refactoring to a single sort-based query using $addFields ($cond premium) + $sort so pagination stays correct, avoids double round-trip, and drops the duplicated non-premium filter.

_reward_referrer uses an atomic {referral_rewarded:{$ne:True}} check for idempotency — good. But the +100 coin credit to the referrer is a separate update_one; if the process dies between the two operations the flag is set without payout. Consider ordering: increment coins first, then set flag (fail-safe: at-most-once with a possible retry) OR wrap in a mongo transaction.
server.py: notify() reads user email on every email=True notification; harmless but adds an extra query per notification. Could denormalize on user object.
PhotoGrid.jsx: on-hover-only reveal of delete/primary buttons is not accessible on touch devices (buttons will never appear). Consider always-visible overlay on mobile.
Wallet.jsx line 140: withdraw input min=100 but backend only enforces amount>0 and <= withdrawable — inconsistency (user could submit 50 via API bypass; not a bug but confusing UX).
ProfileCard.jsx photos rendered without lazy-load — with many profiles this hurts performance.

success_rate.backend: 26/27 (~96%, the 1 failure is a test-side email casing mismatch, not a product bug)

context_for_next_testing_agent: iter3 test file lives at /app/backend/tests/test_giftsdates_iter3.py. Run with `pytest -n 0` (project pytest.ini forces xdist -n 2 --dist loadscope which breaks shared STATE across the tests — either run with -n 0 or refactor STATE into a session-scoped fixture). Referral reward on Stripe purchase not e2e-testable in preview (no real checkout completion); if needed, import backend.server._reward_referrer and call in-process.
